name: @stewardmd/capacitor-whisper
description: On-device Whisper (whisper.cpp) speech-to-text for MaiK Scribe 'Clinical Dictation'. Audio never leaves the device — only recognized text is returned. Fully offline after a one-time model download.
author: StewardMD
_vendored: StewardMD-authored local plugin (SPM on iOS like capacitor-vision-ocr). Links whisper.cpp v1.9.1 (MIT). No JS dist — accessed via Capacitor.Plugins.Whisper. ANDROID INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED: the android NDK/JNI build (whisper.cpp) added ~6MB/ABI to the APK and dominated Gradle build time for no use on Android; voice.js already falls back to native STT / Web Speech / cloud when Capacitor.Plugins.Whisper is absent. To re-enable Android, restore the "android": {"src": "android"} entry under capacitor and the android/* files entries, then `npx cap sync android`.
